dedupe_keys.name: uae fcsc relative distribution of housing units by main source of water and of electricity by household type and emirate 2014 to 2023 bayanat

description: The Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre publishes on the Bayanat open data portal four small tables on how UAE housing units are supplied: the relative distribution of housing units by main water source with nationality and emirate; by main source of electricity with household type and type of housing unit; and by household type with the main source of drinking water and of water for general use. The downloadable resources are titled 2014-2023, and the water source table was last updated on 28 August 2023, the electricity table on 22 July 2022. Round 1 found the FCSC website itself behind a Cloudflare check, and it still is; Bayanat is the open route to its data. Format and access: the files are downloaded from each dataset page (the page viewer does not render them), and Bayanat offers an API for developers. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, as stated on each dataset page; free. Caveats: the tables give percentages, not counts, and at emirate or national level only; the underlying source (census or survey) was not stated on the pages read, and the file format was not visible without a browser. Simulation uses: shares of housing supplied by public networks, desalination or other sources for water and power planning and resilience scenarios. Related records: the Bahrain census 2020 buildings record and the Malaysia household amenities record.
